note: Wordmark: sx widens the font, k adds slant (x += k*y in font units), track is extra space between letters in final units (the word is 100 tall). Fitted so PROPPICKZ in this font matched the banner's lettering (IoU 0.83; Montserrat Black Italic 0.81, Inter Display Black Italic 0.75). Lockup, in word units: the mark is 160 tall, centred on the word, 45 units before it, as on the banner.
